children: Amphenol Corp. (APH) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 06, 2026.

On October 1, 2026, Amphenol Corporation (the "Company") notified its management team that after 43 years with the Company, Luc Walter, President of the Harsh Environment Solutions Division of the Company, would transition, effective January 1, 2027, into a new role as Senior Vice President, Strategic Programs. Ryan Fisher, who currently serves as the Group General Manager of the Company's North American Military Group, will succeed Mr. Walter as President of the Harsh Environment Solutions Division beginning January 1, 2027.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926114035/tm2627036d1_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926114035/0001104659-26-114035-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
